Name: Slightly Cuter June - Ridgeside Village Portrait and Sprite
Author: JuanMiguelito
Description:
This mod changes June's portrait greatly inspired by his original portrait by ch20youk and blends it with the vanilla style. It also replaces the sprites that blend with seasonal aesthetics by Poltergeister. 


I am currently working on making slightly cuter Ridgeside Village sprites and considering how many NPCs there are, I won't be able to make seasonal clothing alone. That goes without saying that this mod will not get a seasonal variant. 



[size=3][b]INSTALLATION:[/b]
[/size][size=3]This mod is a replacer for June in Ridgeside Village. So you must merge my mod and that mod, my mod should overwrite the assets in that mod (the file is "[CP] Ridgeside Village"). 

[b]Please go check out the original and don't forget Ridgeside Village[/b]:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10100]RSV June - Original Art[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿
